sentences.text: The petitioners through their counsel have made a representation dated 08.10.2024, vide Annexure P-3, P 3, to the Director General of Police, State of Punjab, but to no avail.

The prayer made in the aforesaid representa representation tion appears to be that investigation in the FIR in question be conducted not in District Mansa, but in any other District of the State, so that free and fair investigation can be conducted.

5. Every accused in a criminal case has right to expect free, fa fair ir and expeditious investigation and the police authorities have corresponding duty to conduct free, fair and impartial investigation,
without being prejudiced by any extraneous consideration.

6. This Court refrains from entering into merits of the crime against the petitioners and leaves it to the Director General of Police, Punjab, to consider the prayer made in the representation dated 08.10.2024 (Annexure P-3)
3) as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt recei of a copy of this order.

7. Accordingly, petition stands disposed of.
( SHEEL NAGU ) CHIEF JUSTICE November 11, 11 2024 narotam
